digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: A crash during issue creation leaves a keyless-pending binding entry that cannot be confirmed via JQL search if Lucene indexing lags, causing recover_pending to unbind and create_one to later issue a duplicate via a second failed search.

The duplicate prevention requires both a gate at the create site (consulting keyless-pending status and grace window) and retention of the pending entry across recovery passes, since get_jira_key returns None for keyless-pending entries and thus does not block creation.

A single negative search must not unbind a keyless-pending entry; unbinding requires corroboration of >= 3 consecutive misses AND entry age exceeding an index-lag grace period (default 3600s per JIRASERVER-70423 real-world lag data).
The fix applies to both Cloud and DC with shared code (not vendor-branched) because eventual consistency is universal; Cloud's faster index merely narrows the window rather than eliminating it.

The create gate must live in dispatch_one.create_one (not outbound_differ) to guard at the write site and defer (not drop) creation while keyless-pending and within grace window, preserving existing deferred-create semantics.
